projects.name: codex-plugin-cc
projects.description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.
projects.ai_summary: 该项目是一个利用Claude Code中的Codex进行代码审查或任务委派的工具。基于JavaScript实现，通过集成Codex提供自动化代码分析与任务处理能力。

projects.name: meetily
projects.description: Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcription, speaker diarization, and Ollama summarization built on Rust. 100% local processing. no cloud required. Meetily (Meetly Ai - https://meetily.ai) is the #1 Self-hosted, Open-source Ai meeting note taker for macOS & Windows.
projects.ai_summary: 这是一个隐私优先的本地AI会议助手，提供实时转录、说话人分离和摘要功能。采用Rust编写，集成Parakeet/Whisper和Ollama技术，支持完全离线的本地处理。

projects.name: agent-skills
projects.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
projects.ai_summary: 该项目为AI编程代理提供生产级工程技能支持。通过Shell脚本实现关键工程能力的标准化封装与调用。

projects.name: system_prompts_leaks
projects.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Claude Code, Claude Design. OpenAI - ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking, GPT 5.5 Instant, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.
projects.ai_summary: 该项目收集并定期更新多个AI系统（如Anthropic Claude、OpenAI ChatGPT、Google Gemini等）的系统提示词。通过JavaScript实现自动化抓取与整理，提供透明化的AI底层指令集分析。

projects.name: taste-skill
projects.description: Taste-Skill - gives your AI good taste. stops the AI from generating boring, generic slop
projects.ai_summary: 该项目通过JavaScript开发的过滤算法提升AI生成内容质量。采用语义分析与风格评估技术，有效抑制低质模板化输出。

projects.name: herdr
projects.description: agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal.
projects.ai_summary: 该工具是终端环境下的多智能体管理平台，采用Rust编写实现高性能并发。通过轻量级架构统一调度各类CLI代理进程。

projects.name: claude-skills
projects.description: 337 Claude Code skills & agent skills & plugins (30+ Agents, 70+ custom commands, 330+ skills, customizable references, scripts)for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and 8 more coding agents — engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, commercial & finance, and your daily productivity skills.
projects.ai_summary: 该项目提供337个Claude Code技能、代理技能和插件，涵盖工程、营销、产品等10多个领域，提升Claude Code等10余种编码代理的生产力。基于Python实现，包含30+代理、70+自定义命令和330+技能，支持高度定制化引用和脚本扩展。

projects.name: claude-video
projects.description: Give Claude the ability to watch any video. /watch downloads, extracts frames, transcribes, hands it all to Claude.
projects.ai_summary: 该项目赋予Claude AI视频理解能力，通过下载视频、提取帧和转录内容实现视频分析。采用Python技术栈，实现视频处理流程自动化并整合到Claude交互中。

projects.name: last30days-skill
projects.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
projects.ai_summary: 该AI代理技能可跨Reddit、YouTube等平台研究任意主题并生成综合摘要。基于Python开发，整合多平台数据抓取与自然语言处理技术实现信息聚合与提炼。

projects.name: karakeep
projects.description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
projects.ai_summary: 这是一个可自托管的全能书签应用，支持链接、笔记和图片的保存与管理，解决信息碎片化整理问题。采用TypeScript开发，结合AI自动标签和全文搜索技术实现智能化分类与检索。
